scope: Independent reading of the actual written torsion-order and cyclotomic-cancellation proofs; no independent execution of author certificates is claimed.
C:ramified_torsion_infinite: The primary-curvature proof only requires a DVR uniformizer; stable cokernel length is taken modulo m, and its homotopy and exact-sequence arguments do not require pi=p.
A finite cyclic summand of a finite A-submodule containing x has projection pi^(r-e); scaling its map by pi^(m-r) defines a square-zero ring map for every m>=2r.
For m>2e, the intermediate divided binomial terms have valuation (i-1)(m-e)>0, and the final term has valuation (p-1)m-pe>0; this also treats p=2.
Generator twists have residual curvature a*u, so the chosen z-u primary receives exactly the a=1 normalizer twist, with length m-e.
Mackey terms outside the normalizer and all Young permutation classes lift to A and have zero curvature invariant.
A proposed N-fold relation in the polynomial cokernel descends to a finite A-submodule; choosing m>max(2r,2e,Ne) then gives nonzero -Ne mod m.
C:unramified_torsion_infinite: For e=1 every nonzero x killed by p has the exact required pi-order, including the dyadic case.
In a nonzero p-divisible torsion submodule, successive p-preimages increase exact finite pi-order by e; a pi-power then produces exact order e.
C:cyclotomic_torsion_cancellation: The norm relation and (zeta-1)I=0 imply pI=0, so the displayed triangular matrices have p-th power one for odd p.
The exact displayed change of basis gives two admissible free-line sequences and delta(s)=delta(t)+z delta(s-t).
At s=0 the relation yields z^2 delta=delta; z^p=1 and p odd imply z delta=delta, proving additivity.
Normalizer conjugacy by doubling identifies Ind delta(x) and Ind delta(2x), while additivity doubles the latter; thus the induced witness is zero.
Only this witness is cancelled; neither polynomial surjectivity nor a complete ramified criterion is inferred.
